entry.title: New: Resolution 285 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Postponed
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF LATER FISCAL YEARS TO ENTER A MULTI-YEAR AGREEMENT FOR INTERNET TELEPHONE SERVICES TO BE USED BY THE OFFICE OF THE PROSECUTING ATTORNEY

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a five-year agreement with an estimated cost of $260 per year for Voice-over-Internet-Protocol phone service at the office’s workroom located in the Kona Judiciary Complex.

Latest action: Council: Postponed Res. 285-25 to the Call of the Chair - 10/22/25
